segments.comment: B82 C-first hero-to-monster variation based on corrected8 C map output. That run removed the overload and showed the hostile newt immediately north of the wererat; its ten westward moves were a retained target-direction miss. This recipe repeats the human-form individual drops and tin infection, creates the same source-wished hostile newt, shifts into matching wererat form, dismisses the exact observed form notice, then moves north once toward the C-observed adjacent target. Credit hero-to-monster only if C records the natural AD_WERE attack and the complete JavaScript replay matches.
